name: Mutou Ryouta
source:
He is Yuusuke's classmate. He is the grandson of the founder of Mutoh Heavy Industries, a company that dominates the town. He excels at both academics and sports, has good looks, and outwardly maintains a certain level of good conduct, but he makes no attempt to hide his arrogance. He belongs to the soccer club, but is not enthusiastic about club activities and has treated the club room as his personal base at school.
